questions.question: A company is deploying a new application in the cloud and wants to ensure that its data is protected from data breaches. They choose to implement data loss prevention (DLP). Which of the following is a KEY capability of a DLP solution?
answers: Encrypting data at rest.
Monitoring network traffic for sensitive data patterns.
Controlling user access to data.
Preventing denial-of-service attacks.

DLP monitors network traffic.

questions.question: A security engineer is tasked with implementing a system that automatically identifies and quarantines EC2 instances that exhibit suspicious behavior. Which of the following AWS services would be MOST appropriate for this task?

questions.question: An organization is using a container orchestration platform (e.g., Kubernetes) to deploy its microservices.
